t: What Climate Projection Evaluation Database Is All About
title: What Climate Projection Evaluation Database Is All About
description: Climate projections are scored against observations: Hausfather et al. (2020) found 14 of 17 major projections matched warming within uncertainty — models work. CMIP6 ensembles project 2-4°C+ by 2100 depending on emissions (SSP scenarios). Evaluation uses hindcasting (predict the past), regional skill scores, and emergent constraints. The verdict: physics-based models have earned their trust. This database is the complete projection evaluation: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
